bootstrap.method: paired crossed resampling of the three seeds and shared validation complexes

claim_boundaries: This is post-submission matched evidence under independently sequence-predicted AF3 monomer geometry, not the unavailable submitted OpenDDE checkpoint.
The official 455 test authority remains unopened by the campaign until all 36 checkpoints and validation receipts are frozen.
Validation analysis cannot establish prospective biological generalization or clinical utility.
Exact OpenDDE-versus-alternative-predictor substitution remains unresolved unless a hash-bound OpenDDE authority is recovered.
Any later test analysis is report-only and cannot select conditions, thresholds, checkpoints, or manuscript claims retroactively.
interpretation_policy: All deltas are ablation condition minus the full learned-gate reference, paired by seed and validation complex.
A directional component statement requires all three seed effects to agree and the crossed seed-by-complex 95% interval to exclude zero for the named metric.
Otherwise the result is reported as inconclusive or heterogeneous; no favorable metric may erase a cross-task or calibration trade-off.
Validation intervals are descriptive because the same 321-complex validation authority participated in checkpoint selection.
No p-values, best-component ranking, or prospective-generalization claim will be produced from this campaign.

primary_rank_metrics: mean per-complex average precision for contact
mean per-complex average precision for epitope
mean per-complex average precision for paratope
